sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. State Ohm's law and write its equation. (3 marks)
2. Using the circuit diagram, calculate the total current flowing when a 12 V battery is connected to a 6 ohm resistor. (4 marks)
3. A body of mass 2 kg is thrown vertically upwards at 20 m/s. Calculate the maximum height reached. (4 marks)
4. Define the term 'half-life' of a radioactive substance. (2 marks)
5. Calculate the kinetic energy of a body of mass 3 kg moving at 4 m/s. (3 marks)
6. State two differences between series and parallel circuits. (2 marks)
